title: Glossary term
description: One canon (or provisional) vocabulary term (PLAN §2/§7, Q7). Two-tier like code: provisional -> canon via a promotion gate. The glossary-lint hook does a mechanical canon-membership check; the semantic synonym-block prevents drift (e.g. 'twin attitude' must be written 'body-twin'). Seeded from the de-facto PROGRESS vocabulary (PLAN §7.4): body-twin, anchor-baseline aliasing, polhode diameter, hard-shoot trap, ρ-band, ...

id.description: Kebab slug of the term (also the filename). e.g. 'body-twin', 'hard-shoot-trap'.

definition.description: Canonical definition. Should be self-contained and cite the coining run/finding.

status.description: provisional = coined in flight, not yet blessed. canon = promoted; the linter enforces its use and synonym-block.

coined_in.description: run_record id or writeup path where the term first appeared.

promoted_on.description: Date promoted provisional->canon. Absent while provisional.

synonyms_blocked.description: Forbidden synonyms the lint replaces with `term` (the semantic synonym-block, Q7).

aliases.description: Accepted alternate spellings/abbreviations that are NOT blocked (e.g. 'pol_diam' for 'polhode diameter').
